name: Reading by pages, in English: one stage per step, the user's words in every text

en.own-reading-at-night.title: Reading at night
en.own-reading-at-night.description: A habit of your own that grows in small steps.
en.own-reading-at-night.why: Why does this matter to you? In your own words.
en.own-reading-at-night.ending: This habit is yours now. What you built stays, and you decide what comes next.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-1.arrival: The first step is taken. It is small on purpose, and the first piece stands.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-1.accept: The next step is a little more of the same. It is there when you want it.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-1.nugget: You could put what you need where you will see it at your moment, so that starting takes no thought.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-2.arrival: A little more than before, and it held. What you build has grown with it.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-2.accept: There is a next step, a bit larger. You could take it now, or stay here for a while.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-2.nugget: On a full day you could do the smallest version. A tiny step keeps the habit alive.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-3.arrival: This step belongs to your day now. Another piece stands.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-3.accept: The next step grows again by a little. You decide when.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-3.nugget: You could say your plan out loud once: after my moment, I will do my step.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-4.arrival: You have reached the step you set out for. What you built is whole.
en.own-reading-at-night.step-4.nugget: If your moment keeps slipping, you could choose another one that already happens every day.
